report_md:
# Close-momentum weakness exit on a vol-targeted TQQQ core

**Verdict: passes the development bar at 1, 5 and 10 bp, with a qualified
holdout case.** The return engine is a high-exposure, volatility-targeted TQQQ
position. The intraday-close signal is a conditional exit: a negative full-day
QQQ return **in an already-elevated volatility regime** takes the book to cash
for the next 24 hours. That exit is what cuts the drawdown from the 72% of the
vol-only control to 54%.

Dev 2016-01-04..2023-12-29, 1-minute marks, next-open fills, 2% band:

| | CAGR | Max DD | Sharpe | Sortino | Exposure | Fills | Turnover |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| **Strategy, 1 bp** | **46.21%** | **53.87%** | **1.08** | 1.52 | 79.1% | 590 | 1,969x |
| Strategy, 5 bp | 44.19% | 55.32% | 1.05 | 1.48 | 79.1% | 589 | 1,836x |
| Strategy, 10 bp | 41.71% | 57.35% | 1.01 | 1.42 | 79.1% | 589 | 1,684x |
| TQQQ buy & hold | 36.15% | 82.29% | 0.80 | — | 100% | 1 | 1x |
| TQQQ bar from the brief | 36.72% | 82.29% | 0.82 | — | 100% | — | — |

Daily-return correlation to TQQQ: **0.773**. Ending equity $2.08M from $100k
at 1 bp. The strategy beats the CAGR bar by **+9.5 pp** and cuts max drawdown
by **28.4 pp**, and it still clears the bar at 10 bp (41.71%). The drawdown is
2021-11-22 to 2022-11-09, the 2022 bear.

---

## 1. What it is

Universe: QQQ (signal), TQQQ (position), cash. One decision per session at the
close of the **15:29 ET** one-minute bar (15:30), filled at the **15:30 open**.
The target is held until the next 15:30 open, then re-decided.

```
r_k      = QQQ close(15:29) / QQQ open(09:30) - 1     # full intraday return
sigma_k  = annualised stdev of the last 10 completed QQQ daily log returns
           through session k-1 (lagged one session)
base_k   = min(1, 0.20 / sigma_k)
w_k      = 0                        if r_k <= 0 and sigma_k >= 0.20
         = base_k                   otherwise
```

The same 0.20 is the volatility target and the "elevated vol" line. Long only,
weights in [0, 1], idle weight cash at 0%. No intraday stop, no BIL sleeve, no
moving average, no overnight-gap selection, no 15:58→10:01 block. The 2015
daily QQQ closes are used only to warm the 10-day vol so the rule is live on
2016-01-04; the daily parquet is truncated at 2023-12-29 before any rolling
statistic is computed.

**Causality.** The signal uses the 15:29 close; the vol uses daily closes
through the prior session; the fill is the next open. Truncating the panel at
2022-01-03 leaves every prior weight identical (`prior_weights_unchanged =
true`).

**Why this is a close-momentum strategy and not the existing designs.** The
decision variable is one day's intraday return, not a 20/165-day moving
average and not a "sold close" filter. The exit is conditional on the vol
regime: a weak close in a calm tape is a dip and is held; a weak close in a
high-vol tape is a continuation signal and is exited. The holding period is a
continuous 24h position anchored at 15:30, not a fixed 15:58→10:01 block.

## 2. Results

### Yearly returns (daily-close compounding)

| Year | Strategy | TQQQ | Note |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| 2016 | **-2.7%** | +18.6% | whipsaw: see §7 |
| 2017 | +113.0% | +113.0% | full weight all year, no exits |
| 2018 | **+3.2%** | -23.5% | +26.7 pp |
| 2019 | +94.3% | +130.5% | lags a melt-up |
| 2020 | +96.8% | +99.8% | roughly matched |
| 2021 | +58.7% | +90.9% | lags |
| 2022 | **-46.3%** | -79.7% | +33.4 pp |
| 2023 | +168.2% | +204.9% | lags a melt-up |

The pattern is a crash filter: it wins 2018 and 2022, matches 2017/2020, and
lags the strong bull years. The full-window CAGR advantage comes from
compounding the much smaller 2022 loss, not from beating TQQQ every year.

### Sub-periods

| Period | Strategy CAGR / DD | TQQQ CAGR / DD |
|---|---:|---:|
| 2016-2019 | 47.0% / 36.6% | 49.0% / 58.6% |
| 2020-2021 | 75.1% / 33.5% | 93.5% / 72.7% |
| 2022-2023 | +19.3% / 48.7% | -21.7% / 81.1% |

The strategy **lags TQQQ on CAGR in both 2016-2019 and 2020-2021**, while
cutting drawdown by 22 pp and 39 pp. The full-window CAGR edge is concentrated
in 2022-2023, where it makes +19.3% a year while TQQQ compounds at -21.7% a
year. That is a real but regime-dependent edge.

### Costs and turnover

590 fills over 8 years (~74/year). Turnover is 1,969x initial equity because
the book compounds 20x; the notional-weighted number is large but the fill
count is low. Cost sensitivity is 46.21% → 44.19% → 41.71% at 1/5/10 bp, a
4.5 pp drag at 10 bp. The edge survives.

## 3. Pre-registered grid: the plateau

All 8 cells, 1/5/10 bp. Bar: CAGR > 36.72%, DD < 82.29%; target DD < 60%.

| line | window | CAGR 1 bp | CAGR 5 bp | CAGR 10 bp | Max DD | Sharpe | Exposure |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| **0.20** | **10** | **46.21%** | **44.19%** | **41.71%** | 53.87% | 1.08 | 79.1% |
| 0.18 | 10 | 37.14% | 34.96% | 32.30% | 46.36% | 0.97 | 74.6% |
| 0.22 | 10 | 53.28% | 51.40% | 49.07% | 51.17% | 1.16 | 82.3% |
| 0.20 | 5 | 35.79% | 33.88% | 31.52% | 66.29% | 0.89 | 82.0% |
| 0.20 | 15 | 52.66% | 50.48% | 47.81% | 43.58% | 1.19 | 77.0% |
| 0.20 | 20 | 46.09% | 43.97% | 41.38% | 42.51% | 1.09 | 76.6% |
| 0.18 | 20 | 39.15% | 36.99% | 34.35% | 38.69% | 1.02 | 72.8% |
| 0.22 | 20 | 47.43% | 45.55% | 43.17% | 47.73% | 1.07 | 80.2% |

**7/8 clear the CAGR bar at 1 bp; 5/8 clear it at 10 bp; all 8 clear the DD
bar and 7/8 are below 60%.** The centre is not the best cell (window 15 is
52.66%), which is the honest test that the result is a surface and not a
single lucky cell. The two weak corners are the 5-day window (35.79% / 66.29%)
and the low-vol-line cells at 10 bp (32-34%). The 10-day window is the
standard fast-vol choice; it was not chosen because it was best.

## 4. Neighbour tests

| Variant | CAGR | Max DD | Sharpe |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| **Centre** | **46.21%** | **53.87%** | **1.08** |
| signal = last 30 min | 40.59% | 67.95% | 0.99 |
| signal = last 60 min | 32.18% | 68.38% | 0.85 |
| exit threshold -25 bp | 41.67% | 60.17% | 1.00 |
| exit threshold +25 bp | 45.03% | 57.71% | 1.08 |
| decision 15:58 (fill 15:59) | 27.17% | 65.10% | 0.77 |
| vol window 30 | 45.98% | 41.77% | 1.09 |
| line 0.21 | 48.08% | 54.08% | 1.09 |

The full-day signal is the working one: the last 30/60-minute returns are
weaker and have higher drawdowns. The 15:30 decision clock matters — moving it
to 15:58 (missing the last 30 minutes and the close) drops CAGR to 27.17%.
The ±25 bp threshold and the 0.21 line are a plateau. The vol window is the
one real choice: 5 days is too noisy, 10-30 days is the working range.

## 5. Controls: what is doing the work?

| Control | CAGR | Max DD | Sharpe | Exposure |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| **Strategy** | **46.21%** | **53.87%** | **1.08** | 79.1% |
| Vol target only (no close exit) | 44.09% | 72.15% | 0.98 | 90.1% |
| Close exit only (no vol target/gate) | 13.62% | 55.46% | 0.51 | 54.7% |
| Constant weight at the same 79.5% mean | 32.49% | 72.66% | 0.80 | 79.5% |
| TQQQ buy & hold | 36.15% | 82.29% | 0.80 | 100% |

This is the most important table in the report. The **vol-targeted core is the
return engine** (44.09%); the close rule adds **+2.1 pp of CAGR and cuts 18.3
pp of drawdown**. The close exit without the vol gate is far too conservative
(13.62%). The constant-exposure control shows the result is not just
de-levering: at the same average weight, static TQQQ earns 32.49% with a 72.7%
drawdown. The timing and vol scaling together add +13.7 pp CAGR and -18.8 pp
DD versus the static control.

Honest reading: this is a risk-managed TQQQ position whose drawdown target is
met by the close rule, not a close-momentum strategy that generates the return
from the signal alone.

## 6. Placebo, cuts, causality

**Placebo (200 draws).** Keep the vol-target base and the same number of exit
days (313), but draw the exit days at random from the 690 high-vol sessions.
Real 46.21%, placebo mean 39.76%, median 39.45%, 95th percentile 53.80%,
**p = 0.22**. On drawdown: real 53.87%, placebo mean 61.99%, 5th percentile
47.87%, **p = 0.22**. The close timing is directionally favorable (+6.5 pp
over the random-exit mean, -8.1 pp DD) but **not statistically
distinguishable from random exits inside the high-vol set**. The vol regime
does most of the work; the close sign is a modest overlay. This is weaker
evidence than the point estimate suggests and should be read as such.

**Cut tests** (daily returns with one year removed):

| Cut | Strategy CAGR / DD | TQQQ ex-year CAGR / DD |
|---|---:|---:|
| ex-2016 | 54.25% / 52.06% | 38.66% / 81.68% |
| ex-2020 | **38.55% / 52.06%** | 27.84% / 81.68% |
| ex-2022 | 67.93% / 35.72% | 77.75% / 69.89% |
| ex-2023 | **33.69% / 52.06%** | 21.49% / 81.68% |

Excluding 2020 the strategy still clears the absolute bar (38.55%), by 1.8 pp.
Excluding 2023 it does not (33.69%), though it still beats TQQQ by 12.2 pp on
that cut. Excluding 2022 (a strategy win) it lags TQQQ, as expected. The full
window is not one year, but the 2023 dependence is real.

**Causality:** truncating at 2022-01-03 leaves all prior weights unchanged.
The 15:29 signal and the lagged vol are causal.

## 7. The honest weakness: 2016 and the whipsaw

The close rule is a *momentum* rule in a tape with strong daily reversal. In a
V-shaped crash it sells the bottom and re-enters higher. January 2016 is the
clean example: the strategy lost **-30.2%** while TQQQ lost -16.0%, because it
exited after the down days of 13, 19, 21, 25, 27 and 28 January, each followed
by a rebound (the 24h forward returns on those exit days were +5.2%, +1.9%,
+7.3%, +0.7%, +4.3%, +5.8%). The year finished -2.7% versus TQQQ's +18.6%.

That is the cost of the rule, not a data bug. It is why the strategy's edge is
regime-dependent: it shines in prolonged bears (2018, 2022) and suffers in
sharp reversals (2016). The high-vol gate limits the damage (the vol-only
control made +14.8% in 2016) but does not eliminate it.

The exit days are also **not negative-mean on average**:

| 24h TQQQ forward | Mean | Hit rate |
|---|---:|---:|
| All sessions | +20.6 bp | — |
| Exit days | **+6.8 bp** | 48.6% |
| High-vol non-exit days | +26.6 bp | 45.9% |
| Calm days | +22.2 bp | — |

The rule exits days with a *lower but still positive* mean. It is a variance
and tail filter, not a bad-day oracle. The tail benefit is real: on the 20
worst 24h TQQQ returns the full-weight log loss is -1.85; at the strategy's
weights it is -0.79, so ~57% of the worst-20 log loss is avoided. Three of the
ten worst days were exited outright (2020-03-11 -22.9%, 2020-03-13 -16.2%,
2022-06-10 -16.1%); several others were held at 0.20-0.73 weight. It is not
clairvoyant: 2020-09-02 (-18.1%) and 2020-06-10 (-15.7%) were held at full
weight.

## 8. How this differs from the existing work

| Existing | Difference |
|---|---|
| `overnight-drift-filter` (new mandate) | That uses a 20-day SMA trend haircut of 0.5 every day and a 15:58 decision. This uses a **one-day full-intraday return**, a **vol-gated full exit**, and a 15:30 decision. The signal and the exit are different; the vol-target core is the shared family resemblance, and I do not claim otherwise. |
| `revisit/time-of-day` | Selects a 15:58→10:01 block only after a *sold* close, holds ~30% of nights, exits at 10:01. This holds a continuous 24h position, has no sold-close filter, no 10:01 exit, and exits only on vol-gated weakness. |
| `revisit/overnight-crash-filter` | A selective night-continuation / day-reversal system with a 3-sigma gap budget. This has no gap budget, no day-reversal leg, and a 24h hold. |
| Old 165-day SMA + 4% stop base | No 165-day SMA, no stop, no BIL. |

It is **not a diversifier**: daily correlation to TQQQ is 0.773. It is a
risk-managed way to hold the same underlying, which is what the CAGR/DD bar
asks for.

## 9. Honest verdict and holdout risk

**Pass on the stated dev bar.** 46.21% vs 36.72% CAGR, 53.87% vs 82.29% DD,
1.08 vs 0.82 Sharpe at 1 bp, and it survives 5 bp (44.19%) and 10 bp (41.71%).
The 8-cell grid, the constant-exposure control and the causality check are the
parts I trust most.

What I do **not** claim:

- **The close signal is not the return engine.** The vol-targeted core earns
  44.09% by itself; the close rule adds 2.1 pp and cuts 18.3 pp of drawdown.
  The placebo p-value is 0.22 on both CAGR and DD. Read the close rule as a
  tail/variance overlay, not as an alpha signal.
- **The exit days are not negative on average.** They are +6.8 bp versus
  +26.6 bp for high-vol non-exit days. The gain is compounding and tail
  avoidance, not a negative conditional mean.
- **The 2016 whipsaw is real.** January 2016 lost 30.2% versus TQQQ's 16.0%;
  the year lost 2.7% versus +18.6%. A V-shaped crash in the holdout would hurt.
- **2022 still loses 46.3%.** This is a 3x product; it is not low-risk.
- **Ex-2023 CAGR is 33.69%**, below the absolute bar (though 12.2 pp above
  TQQQ on the same cut). The full-window number depends on 2023 being in the
  sample.
- **The holdout risk is asymmetric.** The strategy historically matches
  (2017) or lags (2019, 2021, 2023) strong-bull years. The full 2016-2026 bar
  is 37.54%; the 10 bp dev CAGR is 41.71%, only 4.2 pp above it. A weak
  holdout can erase the edge. The strategy's case rests on the holdout
  containing at least one 2018/2022-type drawdown, or on the vol-targeted
  core matching the bull.
- **It is not a new source of return.** It is TQQQ with a vol target and a
  crash filter. Correlation 0.773.

My recommendation to the lead: take it to the holdout as a **qualified pass**,
not a clean one. It is the best of the close-momentum designs I tested, it
survives costs, and its DD is genuinely below 60%; but the signal's
incremental statistical evidence is weak, and the 2016 whipsaw is the failure
mode to watch.

## 10. Reproduction

```powershell
cd C:\Users\27175\Desktop\quant-trader-research
$env:PYTHONPATH = "C:\Users\27175\AppData\Local\Temp\opencode\pylibs"
$env:BT_THREADS = "1"
python research\new\intraday-close-momentum\strategy.py
```

Outputs `result.json` in the same directory: dev 1/5/10 bp, benchmark, yearly,
sub-periods, the 8-cell grid, neighbours, controls, exit-day forward returns,
the worst-10 table, placebo, cut tests and the causality flag.

# Intraday-close momentum with a volatility-gated weakness exit

**Status:** pre-registered before the final grid run.
**Window:** 2016-01-04 .. 2023-12-29 only. Nothing on or after 2024-01-01 is
loaded by `strategy.py`.

## Hypothesis

TQQQ's return is concentrated in a high-exposure, close-anchored position:
the equity premium and the overnight drift are earned by holding through the
close and the next session. The risk is that a *weak close in an already
volatile tape* is a continuation signal, not a dip. So:

- stay at a volatility-targeted full weight while the tape is calm;
- when realised volatility is at or above the target **and** the full intraday
  return into the close is negative, exit to cash for the next 24 hours;
- re-enter at the next close if the weakness has cleared.

This is a high-exposure, long-only TQQQ timing rule. The close-momentum leg is
a crash/weakness filter; the return engine is the continuous vol-targeted
TQQQ exposure. The claim to test is that the filter cuts the left tail enough
to turn a ~70% drawdown vol-targeted position into a sub-60% one without giving
up the CAGR bar.

## Rules (exact)

Decision at the close of the **15:29 ET one-minute bar** (i.e. 15:30), filled
at the **15:30 open**. One decision per session.

```
r_k      = QQQ close(15:29) / QQQ open(09:30) - 1        # full intraday return
sigma_k  = annualised stdev of the last 10 completed QQQ daily log returns
           through session k-1 (daily adjusted closes; lagged one session)
base_k   = min(1, 0.20 / sigma_k)
w_k      = 0                         if r_k <= 0 and sigma_k >= 0.20
         = base_k                    otherwise
```

`w_k` is held from the 15:30 open of session k to the 15:30 open of session
k+1, then re-decided. No intraday stop, no BIL sleeve, no moving average, no
overnight-gap selection, no 15:58/10:01 time-of-day block. Idle weight is cash
at 0%.

The 0.20 number is used twice: as the volatility target and as the "elevated
vol" line. That is deliberate — one number, not two.

Warmup uses QQQ daily closes from 2015-01-02..2015-12-31 only, so the rule is
live on 2016-01-04. The daily parquet is truncated at 2023-12-29 before any
rolling statistic is computed.

## Pre-registered grid (8 cells)

The two knobs are the common volatility number (`line`) and the vol window.
The signal is always the full intraday QQQ return; the exit is always
`r <= 0 and sigma >= line`.

| # | line | vol window |
|---:|---:|---:|
| 1 | 0.20 | 10 (centre) |
| 2 | 0.18 | 10 |
| 3 | 0.22 | 10 |
| 4 | 0.20 | 5 |
| 5 | 0.20 | 15 |
| 6 | 0.20 | 20 |
| 7 | 0.18 | 20 |
| 8 | 0.22 | 20 |

The centre is the standard fast-vol choice (10 days), not the best cell. The
report must show the whole surface, including cells that fail.

## Pass criteria

- Dev CAGR > 36.72% and max DD < 82.29% at 1 bp.
- Target: CAGR > 36.72% with max DD < 60%.
- Must be reported at 1/5/10 bp. Turnover and fills must be disclosed.
- A cell that only passes at 1 bp is a fail for the programme's purposes.

## Falsifiers

- The close-exit leg adds nothing over the vol-only control (same CAGR, same
  DD).
- The result is a single year (2020 or 2022); cut tests should show it.
- The placebo (random exit days with the same count inside the high-vol
  window) matches the real CAGR.
- Turnover makes the edge disappear at 5 bp.
- Truncating the panel changes prior weights (look-ahead).

## What this is not

- Not a market-neutral or diversifying strategy: correlation to TQQQ will be
  high.
- Not a claim that down closes are bad on average. The unconditional next-24h
  return after a down close is positive in this sample. The claim is
  conditional: down close **and** elevated vol is the bad state.
- Not a re-tune of the 20-day-SMA overnight-drift filter: the signal here is
  one day's intraday return, the exit is conditional on the vol regime, and the
  holding is a continuous 24h position.

"""Intraday-close momentum with a volatility-gated weakness exit.

Standalone strategy, development window only (2016-01-04 .. 2023-12-29).

Rules
-----
Universe: QQQ (signal), TQQQ (position), cash. One decision per session at the
close of the 15:29 ET bar (15:30), filled at the 15:30 open; the target is held
until the next 15:30 open.

    r_k      QQQ full intraday return: close(15:29) / open(09:30) - 1
    sigma_k  annualised stdev of the last `win` completed QQQ daily log
             returns through session k-1 (lagged one session)
    base_k   min(1, line / sigma_k)
    w_k      0                      if r_k <= 0 and sigma_k >= line
             base_k                 otherwise

`line` is both the volatility target and the "elevated vol" line (one number,
not two). Long only, weights in [0, 1]; idle weight is cash at 0%.

The signal is causal: r_k uses the 15:29 close, sigma_k uses daily closes
through the prior session, and the weight is filled at the next open. No
2024+ bar is loaded: the 1-minute panel ends 2023-12-29 and the daily parquet
is truncated at 2023-12-29 before any rolling statistic is computed.

Warmup uses QQQ daily closes from 2015 (the 1-minute archive starts
2016-01-04), so the rule is live on the first development session.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
ROOT = HERE.parents[2]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "research"))
import bt  # noqa: E402

DEV_START = "2016-01-04"
DEV_END = "2023-12-29"
BARS_1M = 252 * 390
SYMBOLS = ("QQQ", "TQQQ")
COL_Q, COL_T = 0, 1

# Pre-registered centre (HYPOTHESIS.md).
LINE = 0.20
VOL_WINDOW = 10
DECISION_MIN = 15 * 60 + 29
SIGNAL = "full_day"

# Pre-registered 8-cell grid: (line, vol_window).
GRID = [
    (0.20, 10),   # centre
    (0.18, 10),
    (0.22, 10),
    (0.20, 5),
    (0.20, 15),
    (0.20, 20),
    (0.18, 20),
    (0.22, 20),
]


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
# data / signals
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
def load_panel(start: str = DEV_START, end: str = DEV_END):
    return bt.panel(SYMBOLS, start, end, "1min", warmup_days=0)


def _session_indices(ts, decision_min: int = DECISION_MIN):
    """First bar (09:30), decision bar (15:29) and last bar (15:59) per day."""
    tod = np.asarray(ts.hour * 60 + ts.minute)
    dates, first, last = bt.day_bounds(ts)
    dec = np.array([
        s + int(np.searchsorted(tod[s:e], decision_min))
        for s, e in zip(first, last)
    ])
    return dates[first], first, last, dec


def _daily_vol(panel_dates, window: int, line: float | None = None):
    """Lagged annualised QQQ daily vol, aligned to the panel session dates.

    The parquet is truncated at DEV_END *before* the rolling statistic, so no
    2024+ observation can influence a 2016-2023 weight.
    """
    daily = pd.read_parquet(bt.DATA_DIR / "QQQ-1d-yahoo.parquet")
    daily["date"] = pd.to_datetime(daily["date"]).dt.date
    daily = daily[daily["date"] <= pd.Timestamp(DEV_END).date()]
    daily = daily.drop_duplicates("date", keep="last").sort_values("date")
    logret = np.log(daily["adjclose"].to_numpy(dtype=float))
    logret = np.diff(logret, prepend=np.nan)
    vol = pd.Series(logret).rolling(window, min_periods=window).std(ddof=0)
    vol = vol.shift(1).to_numpy() * np.sqrt(252.0)
    by_date = pd.Series(vol, index=daily["date"].to_numpy())
    return by_date.reindex(panel_dates).to_numpy(dtype=float)


def _signal(ts, o, c, signal: str, decision_min: int = DECISION_MIN):
    """Per-session causal signal values (r and the decision bar)."""
    dates, first, last, dec = _session_indices(ts, decision_min)
    q_open = np.asarray(o)[first, COL_Q]
    q_dec = np.asarray(c)[dec, COL_Q]
    if signal == "full_day":
        r = q_dec / q_open - 1.0
    elif signal == "last30":
        tod = np.asarray(ts.hour * 60 + ts.minute)
        ref = np.array([s + int(np.searchsorted(tod[s:e], decision_min - 30))
                        for s, e in zip(first, last)])
        r = q_dec / np.asarray(c)[ref, COL_Q] - 1.0
    elif signal == "last60":
        tod = np.asarray(ts.hour * 60 + ts.minute)
        ref = np.array([s + int(np.searchsorted(tod[s:e], decision_min - 60))
                        for s, e in zip(first, last)])
        r = q_dec / np.asarray(c)[ref, COL_Q] - 1.0
    else:
        raise ValueError(f"unknown signal {signal}")
    return dates, first, last, dec, r


def build_targets(ts, o, c, line: float = LINE, window: int = VOL_WINDOW,
                  signal: str = SIGNAL, threshold: float = 0.0,
                  decision_min: int = DECISION_MIN,
                  use_exit: bool = True, use_vol: bool = True):
    """Per-session target weights and diagnostics.

    use_exit=False gives the vol-target-only control; use_vol=False gives the
    close-exit-only control (base weight 1, no vol gate on the exit).
    """
    dates, first, last, dec, r = _signal(ts, o, c, signal, decision_min)
    sigma = _daily_vol(dates, window)
    safe = np.where(np.isfinite(sigma), np.maximum(sigma, 1e-9), 1e9)
    base = np.minimum(1.0, line / safe) if use_vol else np.ones(len(sigma))
    gate = (sigma >= line) if use_vol else np.ones(len(sigma), dtype=bool)
    exit_mask = (use_exit & (r <= threshold) & gate
                 & np.isfinite(sigma))
    target = np.where(exit_mask, 0.0, base)
    target = np.where(np.isfinite(sigma), target, 0.0)
    target = np.clip(target, 0.0, 1.0)
    info = {
        "dates": dates, "first": first, "last": last, "dec": dec,
        "r": r, "sigma": sigma, "base": base, "exit": exit_mask,
        "target": target, "n_sessions": len(dates),
    }
    return target, info


def expand_targets(ts, target, dec):
    """Map one target per session to the (n, 2) bar weights."""
    n = len(ts)
    w = np.zeros((n, 2))
    ends = np.r_[dec[1:], n]
    for k in range(len(dec)):
        w[dec[k]:ends[k], 1] = target[k]
    return w


def build_weights(ts, o, c, line: float = LINE, window: int = VOL_WINDOW,
                  signal: str = SIGNAL, threshold: float = 0.0,
                  decision_min: int = DECISION_MIN,
                  use_exit: bool = True, use_vol: bool = True):
    """Required public API: (n, 2) weights, column 1 is TQQQ, rest cash."""
    target, info = build_targets(ts, o, c, line, window, signal, threshold,
                                 decision_min, use_exit, use_vol)
    w = expand_targets(ts, target, info["dec"])
    assert (w >= 0).all() and (w.sum(axis=1) <= 1.0 + 1e-9).all()
    return w


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
# evaluation helpers
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
def pack(s: dict) -> dict:
    keys = ("cagr", "max_drawdown", "sharpe", "sortino", "volatility",
            "exposure", "turnover", "fills", "ending_equity", "years")
    return {k: (int(s[k]) if k == "fills" else float(s[k])) for k in keys}


def run_weights(ts, o, c, w, slip=1.0, start=DEV_START):
    r = bt.run(ts, o, c, w, start, band=0.02, slippage_bps=slip)
    return r, bt.stats(r, BARS_1M)


def daily_returns(res: dict) -> pd.Series:
    s = pd.Series(res["equity"], index=res["ts"])
    return s.groupby(res["ts"].date).last().pct_change().dropna()


def dd_window(ts, equity):
    eq = np.asarray(equity, dtype=float)
    peak = np.maximum.accumulate(eq)
    dd = eq / peak - 1.0
    j = int(np.argmin(dd))
    i = int(np.argmax(eq[:j + 1]))
    return {"peak": str(ts[i])[:10], "trough": str(ts[j])[:10],
            "dd": float(-dd[j])}


def subperiod(ts, equity, lo, hi):
    m = ((ts >= pd.Timestamp(lo, tz="America/New_York"))
         & (ts < pd.Timestamp(hi, tz="America/New_York") + pd.Timedelta(days=1)))
    x, tt = np.asarray(equity)[m], ts[m]
    if len(x) < 2:
        return None
    years = (tt[-1] - tt[0]).total_seconds() / (365.25 * 86400)
    peak = np.maximum.accumulate(x)
    return {"cagr": float((x[-1] / x[0]) ** (1 / years) - 1),
            "max_drawdown": float(-(x / peak - 1).min()),
            "years": float(years)}


def calendar_year_cut(ts, equity, year: int) -> dict:
    s = pd.Series(np.asarray(equity, dtype=float), index=ts)
    d = s.groupby(ts.date).last()
    r = d.pct_change().dropna()
    r = r[np.array([x.year != year for x in r.index])]
    eq = np.cumprod(1.0 + r.to_numpy())
    years = len(r) / 252.0
    peak = np.maximum.accumulate(eq)
    return {"cagr": float(eq[-1] ** (1 / years) - 1),
            "max_drawdown": float(-(eq / peak - 1).min()),
            "years": float(years)}


def metrics(ts, o, c, w, slip=1.0):
    res, s = run_weights(ts, o, c, w, slip)
    i0 = bt.start_index(ts, DEV_START)
    bench = bt.benchmark(c[i0:, COL_T], ts[i0:], BARS_1M)
    dr = daily_returns(res)
    bd = pd.Series(c[i0:, COL_T], index=ts[i0:])
    bd = bd.groupby(bd.index.date).last().pct_change().dropna()
    out = pack(s)
    out["benchmark"] = {
        "cagr": float(bench["cagr"]),
        "max_drawdown": float(bench["max_drawdown"]),
        "sharpe": float(bench["sharpe"]),
        "volatility": float(bench["volatility"]),
    }
    out["corr_to_tqqq_daily"] = float(dr.corr(bd.reindex(dr.index)))
    out["dd_window"] = dd_window(res["ts"], res["equity"])
    # Yearly from daily closes (bt.yearly attributes the New Year overnight
    # gap to the first bar of the new year, which distorts the first session).
    daily_eq = pd.Series(res["equity"], index=res["ts"])
    daily_eq = daily_eq.groupby(res["ts"].date).last()
    daily_eq.index = pd.to_datetime(daily_eq.index)
    daily_b = pd.Series(c[i0:, COL_T], index=ts[i0:])
    daily_b = daily_b.groupby(daily_b.index.date).last()
    daily_b.index = pd.to_datetime(daily_b.index)
    yearly = {}
    for year in range(2016, 2024):
        e = daily_eq[daily_eq.index.year == year]
        b = daily_b[daily_b.index.year == year]
        if len(e) < 2 or len(b) < 2:
            continue
        yearly[str(year)] = {
            "strategy": float(e.iloc[-1] / e.iloc[0] - 1.0),
            "benchmark": float(b.iloc[-1] / b.iloc[0] - 1.0),
        }
    out["yearly"] = yearly
    return out, res

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
def main():
    ts, o, c = load_panel()
    dates, first, last, dec = _session_indices(ts)
    print(f"panel {len(ts):,} bars, {len(first)} sessions, "
          f"{ts[0].date()} .. {ts[-1].date()}")

    target, info = build_targets(ts, o, c, LINE, VOL_WINDOW, SIGNAL)
    w = expand_targets(ts, target, info["dec"])

    out = {
        "agent": "intraday-close-momentum",
        "strategy": "TQQQ 24h close-anchored momentum with vol-gated weakness exit",
        "window": {"start": DEV_START, "end": DEV_END, "marks": "1m",
                   "fills": "next open, 2% band", "idle": "cash at 0%"},
        "rules": {
            "signal": "QQQ full intraday return, open(09:30) -> close(15:29)",
            "decision": "15:29 ET close, fill 15:30 open",
            "vol": f"annualised stdev of last {VOL_WINDOW} QQQ daily log "
                   "returns through prior session",
            "base": f"min(1, {LINE} / sigma)",
            "exit": f"0 if r <= 0 and sigma >= {LINE}",
            "hold": "15:30 open -> next 15:30 open",
            "line": LINE, "vol_window": VOL_WINDOW,
            "warmup": "QQQ daily closes 2015-01-02..2015-12-31",
            "band": 0.02,
            "slippage_bps": [1.0, 5.0, 10.0],
        },
        "benchmark_tqqq": {},
        "dev": {},
    }

    # ---- costs ------------------------------------------------------------
    results = {}
    for slip in (1.0, 5.0, 10.0):
        m, res = metrics(ts, o, c, w, slip)
        results[slip] = (m, res)
        out["dev"][f"{int(slip)}bp"] = m
        print(f"centre {slip:2.0f}bp  CAGR {m['cagr']*100:6.2f}%  "
              f"DD {m['max_drawdown']*100:5.2f}%  Sharpe {m['sharpe']:4.2f}  "
              f"fills {m['fills']:,}  turnover {m['turnover']:.0f}x  "
              f"exposure {m['exposure']*100:.1f}%")

    m1, res1 = results[1.0]
    i0 = bt.start_index(ts, DEV_START)
    bench = bt.benchmark(c[i0:, COL_T], ts[i0:], BARS_1M)
    out["benchmark_tqqq"] = {k: float(v) for k, v in bench.items()}
    out["benchmark_tqqq"]["bar_from_brief"] = {
        "cagr": 0.3672, "max_drawdown": 0.8229, "sharpe": 0.82}

    out["diagnostics"] = {
        "exit_days": int(info["exit"].sum()),
        "exit_days_pct": float(info["exit"].mean()),
        "eligible_high_vol_days": int((info["sigma"] >= LINE).sum()),
        "avg_target": float(np.mean(info["target"])),
        "days_with_position": float(np.mean(target > 0)),
        "avg_weight_when_in": float(target[target > 0].mean()),
        "mean_sigma": float(np.nanmean(info["sigma"])),
        "decision_bar": "15:29 ET",
        "signal_mean_bp": float(np.nanmean(info["r"]) * 1e4),
    }
    out["subperiods"] = {
        "2016_2019": subperiod(res1["ts"], res1["equity"], "2016-01-04", "2019-12-31"),
        "2020_2021": subperiod(res1["ts"], res1["equity"], "2020-01-02", "2021-12-31"),
        "2022_2023": subperiod(res1["ts"], res1["equity"], "2022-01-03", "2023-12-29"),
    }

    # ---- pre-registered grid ---------------------------------------------
    grid = []
    for line, window in GRID:
        wt = build_weights(ts, o, c, line, window)
        mg, _ = metrics(ts, o, c, wt, 1.0)
        mg5, _ = metrics(ts, o, c, wt, 5.0)
        mg10, _ = metrics(ts, o, c, wt, 10.0)
        grid.append({
            "line": line, "vol_window": window,
            "cagr_1bp": mg["cagr"], "cagr_5bp": mg5["cagr"],
            "cagr_10bp": mg10["cagr"],
            "max_drawdown": mg["max_drawdown"], "sharpe": mg["sharpe"],
            "exposure": mg["exposure"], "turnover": mg["turnover"],
            "fills": mg["fills"], "corr_to_tqqq_daily": mg["corr_to_tqqq_daily"],
        })
        print(f"grid line {line:.2f} win {window:2d}  1bp {mg['cagr']*100:6.2f}%  "
              f"5bp {mg5['cagr']*100:6.2f}%  10bp {mg10['cagr']*100:6.2f}%  "
              f"DD {mg['max_drawdown']*100:5.2f}%  Sh {mg['sharpe']:4.2f}  "
              f"exp {mg['exposure']*100:4.1f}%")
    out["grid"] = grid

    # ---- neighbours (robustness, not used to choose the centre) ----------
    neighbours = []
    for name, kw in [
        ("signal last30", {"signal": "last30"}),
        ("signal last60", {"signal": "last60"}),
        ("exit threshold -25bp", {"threshold": -0.0025}),
        ("exit threshold +25bp", {"threshold": 0.0025}),
        ("decision 15:58", {"decision_min": 15 * 60 + 58}),
        ("vol window 30", {"window": 30}),
        ("line 0.21", {"line": 0.21}),
    ]:
        wt = build_weights(ts, o, c, **kw)
        mn, _ = metrics(ts, o, c, wt, 1.0)
        neighbours.append({"name": name, **{k: mn[k] for k in (
            "cagr", "max_drawdown", "sharpe", "exposure", "turnover", "fills",
            "corr_to_tqqq_daily")}})
        print(f"neigh {name:24s} CAGR {mn['cagr']*100:6.2f}%  "
              f"DD {mn['max_drawdown']*100:5.2f}%  Sh {mn['sharpe']:4.2f}")
    out["neighbours"] = neighbours

    # ---- controls --------------------------------------------------------
    controls = {}
    # vol target only, no close exit
    vol_only = build_weights(ts, o, c, line=LINE, window=VOL_WINDOW,
                             signal=SIGNAL, use_exit=False)
    mv, _ = metrics(ts, o, c, vol_only, 1.0)
    controls["vol_target_only"] = {k: mv[k] for k in (
        "cagr", "max_drawdown", "sharpe", "exposure", "turnover", "fills")}

    # close exit only, no vol target / gate
    close_only = build_weights(ts, o, c, line=LINE, window=VOL_WINDOW,
                               signal=SIGNAL, threshold=0.0, use_vol=False)
    mc, _ = metrics(ts, o, c, close_only, 1.0)
    controls["close_exit_only"] = {k: mc[k] for k in (
        "cagr", "max_drawdown", "sharpe", "exposure", "turnover", "fills")}

    # constant exposure at the same average
    const = float(np.mean(target))
    w_const = np.zeros((len(ts), 2))
    w_const[:, COL_T] = const
    mconst, _ = metrics(ts, o, c, w_const, 1.0)
    controls["constant_exposure_same_mean"] = {
        **{k: mconst[k] for k in ("cagr", "max_drawdown", "sharpe",
                                  "exposure", "turnover", "fills")},
        "weight": const}

    # buy and hold
    w_bh = np.zeros((len(ts), 2))
    w_bh[:, COL_T] = 1.0
    mbh, _ = metrics(ts, o, c, w_bh, 1.0)
    controls["buy_and_hold"] = {k: mbh[k] for k in (
        "cagr", "max_drawdown", "sharpe", "exposure", "turnover", "fills")}
    out["controls"] = controls
    for k, v in controls.items():
        print(f"control {k:30s} CAGR {v['cagr']*100:6.2f}%  "
              f"DD {v['max_drawdown']*100:5.2f}%  Sh {v['sharpe']:4.2f}")

    # ---- diagnostics: what the exit days actually avoided -----------------
    # 24h TQQQ return owned by each session's decision: 15:30 -> next 15:30.
    o_t = np.asarray(o)[:, COL_T]
    fwd = np.full(len(dec), np.nan)
    for k in range(len(dec) - 1):
        a = dec[k] + 1
        b = dec[k + 1] + 1
        if b < len(o_t):
            fwd[k] = o_t[b] / o_t[a] - 1.0
    exit_mask = info["exit"]
    highvol = np.isfinite(info["sigma"]) & (info["sigma"] >= LINE)
    non_exit_hv = highvol & ~exit_mask
    diag = out["diagnostics"]
    diag["forward_24h_all_bp"] = float(np.nanmean(fwd) * 1e4)
    diag["forward_24h_exit_days_bp"] = float(np.nanmean(fwd[exit_mask]) * 1e4)
    diag["forward_24h_highvol_nonexit_bp"] = float(
        np.nanmean(fwd[non_exit_hv]) * 1e4)
    diag["forward_24h_calm_bp"] = float(
        np.nanmean(fwd[~highvol & np.isfinite(fwd)]) * 1e4)
    diag["exit_hit_rate"] = float(np.nanmean(fwd[exit_mask] < 0))
    diag["highvol_nonexit_hit_rate"] = float(np.nanmean(fwd[non_exit_hv] < 0))
    order = np.argsort(np.where(np.isfinite(fwd), fwd, np.inf))[:10]
    diag["worst10_24h_days"] = [
        {"date": str(info["dates"][i])[:10],
         "tqqq_24h": float(fwd[i]),
         "weight": float(info["target"][i]),
         "exit": bool(exit_mask[i])}
        for i in order
    ]
    w20 = order[:20]
    diag["worst20_log_full"] = float(np.nansum(np.log1p(fwd[w20])))
    diag["worst20_log_at_weight"] = float(
        np.nansum(np.log1p(info["target"][w20] * fwd[w20])))

    # ---- placebo: random exit days, same count, inside high-vol days -----
    rng = np.random.default_rng(17)
    sigma = info["sigma"]
    eligible = np.flatnonzero(np.isfinite(sigma) & (sigma >= LINE))
    n_exit = int(info["exit"].sum())
    real_cagr = m1["cagr"]
    real_dd = m1["max_drawdown"]
    draws, dds = [], []
    for _ in range(200):
        pick = rng.choice(eligible, size=min(n_exit, len(eligible)),
                          replace=False)
        t = info["base"].copy()
        t[pick] = 0.0
        t = np.where(np.isfinite(sigma), t, 0.0)
        wt = expand_targets(ts, t, dec)
        _, sp = run_weights(ts, o, c, wt, 1.0)
        draws.append(float(sp["cagr"]))
        dds.append(float(sp["max_drawdown"]))
    draws = np.asarray(draws)
    dds = np.asarray(dds)
    out["placebo"] = {
        "n_draws": 200, "real_cagr": float(real_cagr),
        "mean": float(draws.mean()), "median": float(np.median(draws)),
        "p95": float(np.percentile(draws, 95)),
        "p_value": float((draws >= real_cagr).mean()),
        "real_dd": float(real_dd),
        "dd_mean": float(dds.mean()),
        "dd_p05": float(np.percentile(dds, 5)),
        "dd_p_value": float((dds <= real_dd).mean()),
        "note": "random exit days with the same count drawn from the "
                "high-vol eligible set; tests the close-sign timing, not "
                "the vol regime",
    }
    print("placebo", {k: (round(float(v), 4) if not isinstance(v, str) else v)
                      for k, v in out["placebo"].items()})

    # ---- cut tests -------------------------------------------------------
    cuts = {}
    for year in (2016, 2020, 2022, 2023):
        cuts[str(year)] = {
            "strategy": calendar_year_cut(res1["ts"], res1["equity"], year),
            "benchmark_ex_year": calendar_year_cut(
                ts[i0:], c[i0:, COL_T], year),
        }
    out["cut_tests"] = cuts
    for y, v in cuts.items():
        print(f"cut ex-{y}: strat {v['strategy']['cagr']*100:6.2f}% / "
              f"{v['strategy']['max_drawdown']*100:5.2f}%  "
              f"bench {v['benchmark_ex_year']['cagr']*100:6.2f}% / "
              f"{v['benchmark_ex_year']['max_drawdown']*100:5.2f}%")

    # ---- causality: truncation at 2022-01-03 -----------------------------
    j = bt.start_index(ts, "2022-01-03")
    w_trunc = build_weights(ts[:j], o[:j], c[:j])
    out["causality"] = {
        "truncation_date": "2022-01-03",
        "prior_weights_unchanged": bool(np.allclose(w_trunc, w[:j])),
    }
    print("causality", out["causality"])

    # ---- pass flags ------------------------------------------------------
    out["pass"] = {
        "cagr_above_bar_1bp": bool(m1["cagr"] > 0.3672),
        "dd_below_bar_1bp": bool(m1["max_drawdown"] < 0.8229),
        "dd_below_60_1bp": bool(m1["max_drawdown"] < 0.60),
        "cagr_above_bar_5bp": bool(out["dev"]["5bp"]["cagr"] > 0.3672),
        "cagr_above_bar_10bp": bool(out["dev"]["10bp"]["cagr"] > 0.3672),
        "calmar_1bp": float(m1["cagr"] / m1["max_drawdown"]),
        "benchmark_calmar": float(bench["cagr"] / bench["max_drawdown"]),
    }

    # ---- finite check ----------------------------------------------------
    for key in ("1bp", "5bp", "10bp"):
        for k, v in out["dev"][key].items():
            if isinstance(v, float) and not np.isfinite(v):
                raise ValueError(f"non-finite dev {key} {k}")

    (HERE / "result.json").write_text(
        json.dumps(out, indent=2, default=float), encoding="utf-8")
    print("wrote", HERE / "result.json")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
